downscroll_desc: When enabled, notes scroll downward instead of upward
loading_style_desc: Set the transition style for scene changes.
rm_ms_offset_desc:
Removes the 'xx ms' value shown when a note is hit
Makes the HUD cleaner
scoretxt_bounce_desc: Adds an angled bounce effect to the score text when notes are hit
scoretxt_style_desc: Change the display style of the score text
iconbop_style_desc: Customize the bounce animation style for icons.
iconbop_normalize_desc:
Some icon-bounce styles update per frame
Tries to make the icon bounce/scale recoil independent of refresh rate (consistent on high-refresh displays)
When off, uses the old per-frame formula.
healthbar_style_desc: Change the visual appearance of the health bar.
change_language_desc:
Select the game display language
Changes take effect immediately (except the current screen)
single_splashanim_desc: Force all notes to use a single splash animation.
smooth_hpbar_desc: Make the health bar transitions smoother.
showcase_style_desc: (WIP) Set the showcase style of the results screen
cpu_strums_desc: Enable hit effects for CPU strums
botplaytxt_style_desc: Change the display style of the 'BOTPLAY' text
fpstxt_style_desc: Change the display style of the FPS counter
show_version_desc: Display the current version next to the FPS counter.
show_exrating_desc:
Show extra rating icons
Example filename: sick-extra.png
Avoid enabling in pixel-art scenes, as they are not yet made
rating_bounce_desc: Enhance the bounce animation of rating sprites
exrating_bounce_desc:
Enhance the bounce animation of extra rating sprites
When 'Combo Stacking' is enabled, adds an additional angled effect
rating_opac_desc: Adjust the opacity of rating sprites (100% = opaque)
rm_perfect_judge_desc:
Perfect judgement mode
enable = keep current (use Perfect judgement)
remove = completely remove Perfect judgement
sickPlus = Perfect becomes Sick+ state (Sick rating, but Perfect score. Optional Perfect sprite)
timebar_style_desc: Change the appearance of the in-game time bar
clear_copied_files_confirm:
This will delete all game files that were copied to your device storage.
The game will need to re-copy them from the installation package on next launch.

Do you want to continue?
clear_copied_files_warning:
⚠ WARNING: This action cannot be undone!
All asset files (images, sounds, data, etc.) will be permanently deleted.
The game will restart the copy process on next launch.

Are you absolutely sure?
clear_copied_files_done:
All copied files have been cleared.
The game will re-copy files from the installation package on next launch.
clear_copied_files_failed: Some files could not be deleted. Please check file permissions and try again.
clear_copied_files_nothing: No copied files found. The game files are already up to date.
clear_copied_files_restart: The game will now close. Please restart to re-copy the files.
wintitle_dynamic: Update the window title with the current screen, loaded mod and (while playing) the current song. Disabled automatically when Fake OS Mode is on.
wintitle_state: Display the name of the current screen/state in the window title (e.g. Main Menu, Freeplay).
wintitle_mod: Display the currently loaded mod's name in the window title.
wintitle_song: While playing, display the current song's name in the window title (real-time).
wintitle_difficulty: While playing, also show the current song's difficulty next to its name.
scoretextlanguage_desc: Language shown for the score text (scoreTxt). Auto means follow the game language.
arrow_colormode_desc:
RGB = New palette colors
HSV = Legacy Psych v0.6.3 hue/saturation/value offset
low_quality_desc:
When enabled, disables some background details to reduce load time and improve performance
Note: Some mods may not be optimized for this setting
asset_error_overlay_desc: When enabled, any image that fails to load will show an in-place L-corner marker (with the missing path) exactly where that asset should appear, instead of being silently skipped
antialiasing_desc:
When disabled, turns off anti-aliasing
Slightly improves performance, but makes the image sharper
shaders_desc:
When disabled, turns off shader effects
Some visual effects may be affected
gpu_caching_desc:
When enabled, allows GPU texture caching, reducing memory usage
Not recommended for low-end GPUs
playstate_pixel_perfect_desc:
Keeps all in-game elements sharp and crisp at any resolution
Disable to significantly improve scrolling performance on full-screen or high-resolution displays (recommended for low-end devices, visually negligible)
framerate_desc: Set the maximum framerate for the game.
fps_rework_desc:
How it works:
When FPS drops below the cap, the game won't become choppy
fps_warning_1:
Warning: Recommended FPS range is 60-240
Because Psych Engine is designed this way
fps_warning_2:
Ah, if you insist on tweaking it this way, then suit yourself~
——KittyCathy
notesplash_desc: Select your preferred Note Splash variation.
notesplashopacity_desc: How transparent should the Note Splashes be.
hidehud_desc: When checked, hides most HUD elements, keeping only the arrows
timebar_desc: What do you want the time bar to display?
flashinglights_desc:
Photosensitive epilepsy warning
The game includes flashing effects. If you are sensitive to flashing, disable this immediately!
camerazooms_desc: If unchecked, the camera won't zoom in on a beat hit.
scoretextgrow_desc: When disabled, the score text won't have a grow animation when notes are hit
healthbaropacity_desc: Set the opacity of the health bar and icons
vsync_desc:
If checked, Enables VSync fixing any screen tearing at the cost of capping FPS to screen refresh rate.
(Must restart game to have an effect)
pausemusic_desc: What song do you prefer for the Pause Screen?
checkforupdates_desc: On Release builds, turn this on to check for updates when you start the game.
receivebetabuilds_desc:
If checked, update checks read the dev (pre-release) version from gitVersion.txt.
Otherwise only the release (stable) version is checked.
discordrpc_desc: Uncheck this to prevent accidental leaks, it will hide the Application from your "Playing" box on Discord
combostacking_desc:
If unchecked, Ratings and Combo won't stack, saving on System Memory and making them easier to read.
Disabling this will also automatically disable rating bounce options
(such as Rating Bounce and Extra-Rating Bounce).
middlescroll_desc: If checked, your notes get centered.
opponentnotes_desc: If unchecked, opponent notes get hidden.
ghosttapping_desc: When to punish empty arrow presses (pressing without matching notes).
description_ghost_tapping-off:
All empty arrow presses trigger full miss penalty (noteMissPress)
with health loss, score penalty, combo break.
description_ghost_tapping-whenNotSinging:
Reverse behavior: Punishes when NO player notes are in hit range.
Safe spamming when notes are present; penalizes random presses in gaps.
description_ghost_tapping-whenSinging:
FPS Plus + Funkin original: Punishes when player side has notes in hit range.
Includes 375ms anti-spam cooldown per direction.
Safe spamming between note gaps.
description_ghost_tapping-always:
Classic PsychEngine/Kathy behavior:
Empty arrow presses never penalize, only trigger onGhostTap script callbacks.
autopause_desc: If checked, the game automatically pauses if the screen isn't on focus.
popupscore_desc:
When disabled, hitting notes won't pop up ratings like 'Sick' and combos
Slightly reduces presentation, but suits low-end devices
disablereset_desc: If checked, pressing Reset won't do anything.
keyviewer_desc: Show a key indicator on the play screen (JKPS-style), following your actual key bindings.
keyviewer_profile_desc:
Shows images/keyviewer/icon.png on the left of the key display
Shows custom text at the bottom (editable in images/keyviewer/name.txt)
ps: No left gap when there is no icon.
keyviewer_reset_total_desc: Reset the cumulative key Total back to 0.
keyviewer_trail_desc:
Direction the key trail (white block) is generated
Auto is opposite to the in-game scroll setting (downscroll)
Up forces from the top of the key upward, Down forces from the bottom of the key downward.
keyviewer_pos_desc: Open a screen to drag the Key Viewer panel with mouse or touch to reposition it. Saved automatically.
keyviewer_cal_hint_mobile:
Drag the panel below to adjust the Key Viewer position.
B (bottom-right) = Save & Back · C (bottom-left) = Reset to default
keyviewer_cal_hint_desktop:
Drag the panel below to adjust the Key Viewer position (mouse or touch).
R = Reset to default · ESC / BACK = Save & Back
keyviewer_trail_speed_desc: Movement speed of the key trail (white blocks). Higher = faster.
gameovervibration_desc: When enabled, the device vibrates on failure (BlueBall)
sustainsasone_desc:
When enabled, hold notes are judged only once; cannot be pressed again after a MISS
Disable to restore the old input method
hitsoundvolume_desc: Plays a 'loud' hit sound effect when notes are hit
ratingoffset_desc:
Changes how late/early you have to hit for a "Sick!"
Higher values mean you have to hit later.
perfectwindow_desc: Adjust the timing window (in milliseconds) for achieving a 'Perfect!!' rating.
sickwindow_desc:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a "Sick!" in milliseconds.
goodwindow_desc:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a "Good" in milliseconds.
badwindow_desc:
Changes the amount of time you have
for hitting a "Bad" in milliseconds.
hitwindowpreset_desc:
Apply preset hit-window timings with one click
Leather / Psych / Funkin'
safeframes_desc:
Changes how many frames you have for
hitting a note earlier or late.
note_colors_tip: Press {$0} to Reset the selected Note Part.
note_colors_hold_tip: Hold {$0} + Press RESET key to fully reset the selected Note.
adjust_delay_combo_desc: Calibrate note/beat delay and adjust the display position of combo and judgment
adjust_rating_offset_desc: Tap to the beat to measure and set your input delay
ratingoffset_cal_warmup: Get ready... tap on the beat
ratingoffset_cal_applied: Applied! Rating Offset set to {0} ms
graphics_desc: Adjust resolution, framerate, and quality settings
visuals_desc: Modify visual effects and HUD elements
window_manager_desc: Create, close, and manage multiple extra windows (Windows only)
fps_position_desc: Set the position of the FPS counter on screen
fps_spacing_desc: Adjust the spacing between FPS counter and screen edges
camhud_zoom_desc: Adjust the zoom level of HUD elements.
legacy_notepos_desc: Use the old note position system.
legacy_hud_desc: Legacy Psych (0.6.x) compatibility: HUD elements are added directly to the state instead of uiGroup, so old mod scripts can locate them via getObjectOrder/setObjectOrder.
charting_version_desc:
Which Chart Editor to open.
1.0.4-Kathy is the enhanced chart editor and is the default.
1.0.4-Official is the original PE 1.0.4 editor.
0.7.3 and 0.6.3 are recreations of the older editors (with automatic chart conversion).
lua_compat_version_desc:
Determines default arguments of Lua API functions like setObjectCamera / doTween* / makeAnimatedLuaSprite.
1.0.4 = KathyEngine native (default).
0.7.3 / 0.6.3 = match legacy PE behavior for older mod scripts.
auto = reserved (currently falls back to 1.0.4).
mod_compat_checker_desc:
Scans a mod's .lua / .hx scripts and reports which Lua functions & callbacks it uses that are incompatible with Kathy, Psych 1.0.4 or Psych Legacy (0.7.3 / 0.6.3).
Static analysis only (an optional run-probe can be enabled); results are a reference, not a guarantee.
ratings_pos_desc: Set the position of the ratings on screen.
events_debug_desc:
(Experimental feature)
Sacrifices some performance to display event info; only works in Charting Mode!
bot_addscore_desc:
If enabled, the BOT also gains score when hitting notes
(To prevent cheating, bot hits are not counted toward the final score)
botplay_perfect_timing_desc: If enabled, hit timing in BOT mode will always display as 0ms
use_system_cursor_desc: If enabled, the game will use your system's default mouse cursor.
nps_desc: Show notes hit per second (NPS) in the score text line
mods_import_desc:
(Experimental Feature)
If enabled, you can import mods by dragging and dropping mod ZIP files.
hud_zoomstyle_desc: Adjust the zoom style of the HUD elements.
bgvol_desc:
Enable background volume adjustment.
This requires 'Auto Pause' to be disabled.
bgvol_level_desc:
Adjust the volume when the game is in the background
Requires 'Auto Pause' to be disabled
gameplay_combospr_desc: When notes are hit, adds a pop-up effect for the 'Combo' sprite
fixed_timestep_desc:
Use fixed timestep
May alleviate frame drops, but causes game visual lag at low FPS
ratcounter_desc: Enable the rating counter to display the number of hits for each rating type.
watermark_desc: Show a small watermark on the game screen (like Kade Engine)
force_hold_animations_desc:
When enabled, playable characters' holds only play their sing animation once at the start and keep the pose, instead of re-triggering every segment
Similar to official Funkin
When disabled, vanilla Psych behavior is used (re-plays sing each segment when no -hold animation exists)
show_haxelibs_desc: Additionally show Haxelib libraries and their version info in the FPS counter
keep_sing_animation_desc: Always keep the sing animation while holding arrows, without auto-returning to idle (for the Hyperactive achievement)
resource_caching_desc: Cache resources when reloading songs to speed up loading times
enable_game_log_desc: Enable in-game log display (Press F3 to toggle)
show_game_version_desc: Show Psych Engine and MintRhythm Extended version and commit info
fps_text_color_desc: Change the color of FPS counter text
fps_bg_color_desc: Change the color of FPS counter background
fps_text_opacity_desc: Adjust the opacity of FPS counter text
fps_bg_opacity_desc: Adjust the opacity of FPS counter background
fps_font_size_desc: Change the font size of FPS counter
fps_bg_padding_desc: Adjust padding around FPS counter text
fps_force_mb_desc: Always display memory in MB instead of auto-scaling to GB
simpleinfo_text_color_desc: Change the text color of Simple FPS counter
simpleinfo_font_size_desc: Change the font size of Simple FPS counter
simpleinfo_show_mem_desc: Toggle memory usage and peak display
lane_cover_p1_desc: Transparency of the shadow/cover overlay on your lane. 0 = off, 1 = darkest.
lane_cover_p2_desc: Transparency of the shadow/cover overlay on the opponent's lane. 0 = off, 1 = darkest.
lane_cover_strum_alpha_desc: When enabled, the cover overlay opacity is multiplied by the receptor's own alpha (darkens automatically with middleScroll etc.).
precise_hit_desc: Millisecond-accurate hit timing: judges notes using the audio clock at the exact moment of input and recomputes the hit window live, removing ~1 frame of judgment lag and edge mis-hits.
input_system_desc:
Select the input judgement system mode
Default = Classic mode (by time order, prioritize hitting valid notes)
Rhythm = Prioritize hitting the valid note closest to the judgement line
gc_on_resume_desc: Force a memory cleanup when resuming the game (may cause a brief stutter on resume).
hold_release_instant_miss_desc: Only effective with Sustains as One Note on: releasing a hold during its body instantly counts as a Miss (stricter and more immediate than vanilla).
hold_tail_judge_desc:
The tail of a hold note also counts as a valid hit
Hitting the tail adds combo and records a rating
Tip: Good play gives no reward, bad play gives penalty () — kittycathy332
hold_tail_leniency_desc:
When enabled, the hold tail judgement (by release timing) additionally widens the judgement window, making it easier to hit
Requires Hold Tail Judgement.
hold_tail_leniency_ms_desc:
Leniency in milliseconds for hold tail judgement
Each rating window and the hit window cap are widened by this value (default 20, range 0-50).
hold_note_tail_fix_desc:
Hold note tail judgement optimization: fix tail timing to avoid breaking the hold even when held to the visible tail
off = original, extend = extend the end to the visible tail, earlyHit = widen early-end hits, both = use both.
mobilejudgmentcomp_desc: Automatically adds a judgment offset on touch input to compensate for touch latency.
mobilejudgmentoffset_desc: Touch input judgment compensation amount (in milliseconds).
hitsound_desc: Select the hitsound played when you hit a note.
hitsound_pitch_offset_desc: When enabled, the hitsound pitch shifts with your hit timing: earlier hits sound higher, later hits lower, giving audible feedback on timing accuracy.
hitsound_pitch_range_desc: Pitch deviation at the edge of the hit window relative to the base pitch (e.g. 0.25 = about +/-25% pitch at the edge).
hitsound_pool_enabled_desc: Reuse FlxSound instances to play hitsound/missnote, reducing allocation and GC stutter on dense charts.
hitsound_pool_size_desc: Number of concurrently available hit sounds. Raise it for extremely dense charts; lower it to save memory.
shitwindow_desc: Bottom fallback judgment window; also the fixed upper bound for safeZoneOffset.
useshitwindow_desc: When enabled, safeZoneOffset uses the Shit Window fixed value instead of being computed from Safe Frames.
softedge_desc: Enables soft interpolation on the outermost 20% of each judgment window to avoid judgment jumps at the boundary.
developer_mode_desc: Enable to access the editor menu (chart/character/stage...). In legacy main menu, shows the toolbox entry.
show_mode_label_ms_desc: Show (BOT) or (REPLAY) label in the ms timing text.
ghost_effect_desc: Show a ghost afterimage of the character when hitting multiple notes at once.
health_overflow_desc:
Requires Smooth HP Bar
Allows health to exceed 100% and pushes the health icon past the edge of the bar.
health_overflow_drain_desc: Speed at which overflow health drains back to 100%; higher values drain faster. Depends on Smooth HP Bar and Health Overflow Icons.
smooth_hp_speed_desc: How tightly the health bar eases to the real health. Higher = snappier (less lag). Requires Smooth HP Bar.
stage_quality_desc:
Vector/text rendering quality (StageQuality),
Lower is faster on mobile but text is blurrier. Takes effect immediately; restart to ensure a full redraw.
auto_song_resync_desc:
On weak devices, when audio/video/logic desyncs, the engine rewinds the song
Disable to avoid sudden rewind; may require manual calibration.
frame_adaptive_sync_desc:
Dynamically adjusts the timing sync speed based on your target framerate.
At 60fps it behaves identically to the default (K=5); at lower framerates the sync K drops proportionally
for smoother scrolling.
sync_speed_multiplier_desc:
Additional multiplier for the frame-adaptive sync speed (0.1 = very slow, 1.0 = default, 10 = max).
Only takes effect when Frame-Adaptive Sync is enabled.
hide_missed_notes_desc:
Stop drawing notes that have been missed and scrolled off-screen (or are severely lagging)
Reduces rendering load on SPAM charts. Misses are still counted normally.
instant_resolve_expired_desc: Notes past the miss window are settled immediately instead of drawn for a few frames. Prevents lag-spiral avalanches in SPAM charts. Judgement unaffected.
disable_note_lua_desc: Skip Lua/HScript callbacks (onSpawnNote / goodNoteHit / noteMiss / opponentNoteHit) for every note. Big boost in dense charts. WARNING: breaks modcharts relying on these callbacks.
max_notes_per_frame_desc: Cap how many note sprites can be created in one frame (0 = unlimited). After a lag spike the backlog spreads over several frames. Notes are never dropped, only delayed a frame or two.
note_optimization_desc: Comprehensive note performance optimization: container optimizations, trig/timing caches, and memory layout improvements (does not change note object lifecycle; script-safe). Turning it off falls back fully to the original logic for easier troubleshooting.
note_pooling_desc:
⚠ Only enable if you are sure your chart/modchart does not rely on persistent note object references
When enabled, reuses normal note instances per-column in buckets to eliminate GC pauses
If your scripts' onSpawnNote/goodNoteHit/noteMiss store Note references and read them across spawns, they may read dirty reused data.
lua_note_index_perf_desc:
Use the stable spawn-order index for Lua/HScript note callbacks (onSpawnNote / goodNoteHit / noteMiss / opponentNoteHit) instead of scanning the whole notes array (notes.members.indexOf). Cuts a big CPU cost in dense charts while scripts are active.
⚠ When ON, the 'index' scripts receive is the stable spawn order, not the note's current position in the notes array.
Leave OFF (default) if a modchart depends on the array-position semantics — default matches original Psych behavior for full mod compatibility.
batch_compact_notes_desc:
When ON, destroyed notes are not spliced immediately; the notes / normalNotes / holdNotes arrays are compacted once at the end of each frame instead.
Turns the 3× O(n) per-note removals in dense charts into a single O(n) pass — the main CPU win on the destroy path.
⚠ Trade-off: scripts observing notes.length in the same frame after a hit/miss see one extra frame of stale members.
Turn OFF to revert to the original destroy-then-splice behavior (length updates immediately for scripts).
ratcounter_anim_desc: Adds an extra animation when the rating counter updates.
enable_console_log_desc: Output game logs to the system console (terminal).
time_bar_gradient_desc: Works with Psych and Leather (Legacy) styles. Gradient from opponent color to player color.
ba_language_desc: Select language for Blue Archive loading transition.
bigger_info_text_desc: When toggled, the time bar uses a larger font.
startup_splash_desc: Choose the startup splash: Custom Logo = Kathy intro animation; Flixel = Flixel built-in splash; None = go straight into the game.
optimized_note_loading_desc: Auto-detects high-density charts and uses optimized loading. OFF = always legacy, ON = always optimized, AUTO = based on chart NPS.
playstate_adaptive_width_desc: Allows PlayState to adapt its width to the window (960-1680px), height locked at 720. Better display on wider screens.
chart_editor_follow_window_desc: When ON, the Chart Editor resolution follows the window size (720p-1080p adaptive). When OFF, uses the game default fixed resolution (1280x720).
splash_limit_desc: Limit the maximum number of simultaneous note splashes. OFF = no limit.
max_splashes_desc: Maximum number of note splashes that can exist at once. Only works when Splash Limit is ON.
splash_limit_mode_desc:
Behavior when the splash limit is reached:
Skip = ignore the new splash (current)
Replace = destroy the oldest splash and spawn the new one.
hold_cover_limit_desc: Limit the maximum number of simultaneous hold cover effects. OFF = no limit.
max_hold_covers_desc: Maximum number of hold cover effects that can exist at once. Only works when Hold Cover Limit is ON.
loading_threads_desc: Number of threads used to preload assets when entering a song (1 = single-threaded; higher = more parallel loading but uses more memory).
show_loading_screen_desc: Show the loading screen transition when entering a song. Disable to skip it and switch directly (may cause a brief freeze while assets load).
freeplay_framed_loading_desc:
Build the Freeplay song list and icons across frames when entering (visible window first, the rest on idle frames)
Reduces the loading stutter when entering; recommended for low-end devices
hold_cover_skin_desc: Select the Hold Cover skin to use. Requires holdCover/holdCover{Color}{Skin}.png and optional .json configs.
three_icons_desc: Enables 3-state health icons: Normal / Lose / Win. The icon image should be a wide rectangle with the three states left-to-right. You can also use a 450x150 sheet of 3 square icons. When disabled, classic 2-state square icons are used.
load_leather_icons_desc: Choose the health icon style. 'default' uses the built-in Psych format; 'leather' prioritizes Leather Engine format icons (leather/<name>-icons.png). Mods' leather icons take priority automatically. Falls back to default if not found.
opponent_splashes_desc: Show NoteSplash effects when opponent hits notes. Requires CPU Strums visible. Compatible with playOpponent mode.
hold_covers_desc: Show a glow effect on the receptor while holding sustain notes, with a burst animation at the end of the hold. (Like vanilla FNF)
opponent_hold_covers_desc: Show Hold Cover effects on the opponent's side too. Requires CPU Strums and Hold Covers enabled.
note_timer_desc:
When there's ≥3 seconds between player arrows, shows a circular countdown ring and number in the middle of the screen
Ported from Leather Engine.
note_timer_layer_desc:
Choose whether the countdown circle and number render above or below the arrows.
Above Notes = circle covers arrows
Below Notes = arrows cover circle.
note_timer_display_desc:
What the number inside the countdown circle represents.
Seconds = remaining seconds (rounded up)
Beats = remaining beats (rounded up, changes with BPM).
note_timer_stepped_desc:
When enabled, the circle no longer shrinks smoothly every frame — it jumps by whole beat/second steps.
Pairs with Beats mode for a circle that pulses on every beat.
fps_counter_style_desc: Choose between Kathy (detailed), Psych (vanilla), Simple (Leather) or V-Slice (vanilla FNF) style.
fps_settings_button_desc: Customize the FPS counter style currently in use.
simple_info_settings_button_desc: Customize Simple (Leather) style FPS counter appearance and content.
debug_fps_settings_desc: Customize the vanilla FNF Debug FPS counter (Simple text / Advanced graphs).
debug_mode_desc: Off hides it. Simple shows text only. Advanced adds real-time line graphs for FPS, GC and task memory.
debug_text_color_desc: Color of the text and the graph lines.
debug_bg_outer_desc: Outer border color of the background panel.
debug_bg_inner_desc: Inner background color of the panel.
debug_bg_opacity_desc: Opacity of the background panel (0 = invisible).
debug_font_size_desc: Text size used in the Debug panel.
debug_font_desc: Font used in the Debug panel: VCR or Quantico.
debug_panel_width_desc: Minimum inner width of the panel; if any displayed text is wider, the background auto-widens to wrap it.
debug_update_delay_desc: How often the display refreshes, in milliseconds.
debug_history_len_desc: How many past samples each graph keeps.
debug_show_fps_graph_desc: Show the FPS line graph (Advanced mode).
debug_show_avg_desc: Show the average FPS line on the FPS graph.
debug_show_low_desc: Show the 1% low FPS line on the FPS graph.
debug_show_gc_desc: Show the GC memory graph (Advanced mode).
debug_show_task_desc: Show the task memory graph (Advanced mode).
debug_graph_smooth_desc: Smooth the line graphs with quadratic Bézier curves for a softer look.
debug_reset_defaults_desc: Restore every V-Slice debug panel setting to its default value.
disable_networking_desc: Blocks all internet usage at once: update checks, tip fetches, external links and Discord RPC.
legacy_main_menu_desc: Use the old Psych Engine main menu style.
fake_window_title_desc: Choose the preset window title you want the game to display.
fake_os_version_desc: Choose what OS Engine version the game (and mods) should detect.
fake_psych_version_desc: Choose what Psych Engine version the game (and mods) should detect.
legacy_class_alias_desc:
When on, legacy short class names (e.g. Note, PlayState) from 0.6.3/0.7.3 scripts are auto-mapped to their new package paths;
when off, only the new full-path syntax is supported (e.g. objects.Note, states.PlayState).
single_hold_note_animation_desc: Only play confirm animation once when holding long notes.
auto_reset_strum_anim_desc: Automatically reset strum notes to default animation (both normal taps and hold notes).
fallback_perfect_to_sick_desc:
If a mod doesn't have perfect/marvelous rating images, use the sick image instead.
In Sick+ mode: OFF=Show Perfect texture, ON=Show Sick texture.
fallback_experfect_to_sick_desc:
If a mod doesn't have ex-perfect/ex-marvelous rating images, use the sick image instead.
In Sick+ mode: OFF=Show Perfect texture, ON=Show Sick texture.
sound_tray_style_desc: Choose the style of the sound tray.
hold_note_behind_desc: Place hold notes behind normal notes and strum arrows.
extra_controls_desc: Choose how many extra buttons you want? They can be used for gameplay mechanics created by LUA or HScript.
extra_key_bindings_desc: Choose which specific key each extra button simulates.
hitbox_hide_idle_desc: Hides the colored hitbox blocks while not being touched.
extra_bind_hint: Select a key slot, then tap the key you want it to simulate.
pad_extra_save:
Pad-Extra Is Just A Binding Option
Please Select A Different Option To Exit.
mobile_controls_opacity_desc: Choose the opacity of mobile buttons (be careful not to set to 0, or you won't find them).
allow_phone_screensaver_desc: If checked, the phone will sleep after going inactive for a few seconds (time depends on your phone's options).
wide_screen_mode_desc: If checked, the game will stretch to fill your whole screen. WARNING: can result in bad visuals and break some mods that resize the game/cameras.
hitbox_design_desc: Choose how your hitbox should look like.
hitbox_position_desc:
If checked, the hitbox will be put at the top of the screen and the extra buttons at the bottom, otherwise the opposite. 
(Only takes effect when extra buttons are enabled)
hitbox_animation_desc: If checked, hitbox buttons will have animation when pressed/released.
dynamic_controls_color_desc: If checked, the mobile controls color is set to the notes color in your settings (effect during gameplay only).
rating_fall_style_desc: Modify the fall animation of rating sprites
camellia_scale_mode_desc: Scale basis for the Camellia style. Proportional: keeps the engine's current size and only adds the rebound animation. Original: uses VSCam's raw values, making the rating sprite noticeably smaller for the most faithful look.
rating_fall_style_combostacking_note: (Only the Leather style requires Combo Stacking OFF: with it ON, Leather falls back to the default upward jump and loses its downward effect; Legacy is unaffected, and Camellia always applies.)
health_overflow_drain_requirement: Smooth HP Bar + Health Overflow enabled
combo_num_display_desc: How the combo number is displayed during gameplay.
ms_timing_style_desc:
Style of the ms timing text shown on each NOTE HIT.
Kathy = persistent static text near the combo (Psych-style), updates in place and fades out.
Kade = a per-hit popup that floats up from the rating area, colored by judgment (bad/shit red, good green, sick cyan).
ms_timing_offset_mode_desc:
How the ms timing text position is offset.
independent = use its own dedicated offset (editable by dragging in the Combo Offset menu).
numScore = follow the combo number (Score) offset instead.
mod_compat_no_mods: No mods found in the mods/ folder.
mod_compat_pick_hint: Pick a mod to scan its .lua / .hx scripts.
mod_compat_all_ok: No compatibility issues found. Looks fine!
mod_compat_hint_report: [Up/Down] Scroll   [Accept] Deep re-scan   [Back] Back to list
show_event_information: Show Real-time Event Info in Charting Mode
watermark_type_desc: Set the engine type shown in the game watermark.
break_combo_shit_desc: Break the combo when hitting a Shit note. Disabling this also disables 'Break combo on Bad'.
break_combo_bad_desc: Break the combo when hitting a Bad note. Requires 'Break combo on Shit' to be enabled.
accuracy_mode_desc: Choose how accuracy is calculated: Accurate uses fixed rating weights, Complex uses Kade/wife3 millisecond precision.
sustain_accuracy_desc: When enabled, sustain (tail) hits count toward accuracy; when disabled they are completely ignored.
kade_scoring_desc: Enable Kade scoring: bad=0 / shit=-300 / good=200 / sick=350. Hitting a Shit breaks the combo and counts as a Miss, and Kade's hit/miss health is applied.
kade_hold_visual_desc: Enable Kade hold visuals: sustains render as segments, and the part of the hold that has passed the judge window fades to 0.3 (visual only, doesn't affect judgment or replays).
touch_lane_mode_desc: Touch lane mode for extra keys: auto = match chart key count, 4k = always 4 keys.
show_key_preview_desc: Show a keybind preview at the start of a song.
psych_line_fps_desc: Color of the FPS display line
psych_line_mem_desc: Color of the Memory display line
psych_line_version_desc: Color of the Version display line
psych_line_commit_desc: Color of the Commit display line
psych_line_os_desc: Color of the OS display line
psych_font_size_desc: Size of the FPS counter text (8-32)
psych_font_name_desc: Font used for the FPS counter
psych_text_opacity_desc: Opacity of the FPS counter text (0-100%)
psych_bg_color_desc: Color of the FPS counter background
psych_show_peak_desc: Show peak memory usage alongside current
psych_show_nogc_desc: Show (No GC) marker when garbage collection is disabled
fps_settings_menu_desc: Choose which FPS counter style to customize
debug_graph_text_gap_desc:
Vertical gap between the graph and its label above it
Increase to avoid the text hugging the graph
menumusic_desc: Which music plays in menus and other screens. Drop audio in assets/music/ named freakyMenu-<option> (Default uses the standard freakyMenu).
beat_scale_desc: When enabled, the title screen and main menu bounce with the beat (title: 3%, menu: 1.5%).
fallback_perfect_to_sick: Perfect Rating Sprite Fallback to Sick
fallback_ex_perfect_to_sick: Extra Perfect Rating Sprite Fallback to Sick
leather_script_compat_desc: When not off, enables the LE API runtime and coexists with Psych API: auto = auto-route each script by content (LE-API scripts run LE, Psych-API scripts run Psych; both can coexist in one mod), official/lts = force all scripts to LE API; off = all Psych API
modsimport_detected: Detected an importable mod package. Import it into the mods folder?
